expedition: Beyond the Blue: Papahanaumokuakea ROV and Mapping
purpose: The goal of EX2503 Dive 16 was to explore a southeastern ridge arm of Paul Seamount, an unexplored seamount in the Wentworth seamount chain. Exploration on a similar seamount just north of Paul seamount by E/V Nautilus in 2018 located an extremely large Hemicorallum community. Our goal was to dive at a similar depth range–between 1920 and 1740 meters depth–on a ridge of comparable bathymetry to see if a similar community was present on this unexplored seamount.
